name: register-vm-in-swift
description: A Swift Playground for the Wikibook "Creating a Virtual Machine" by Jeffrey Meunier

paragraphs: A Swift playground corresponding to a chapter in the Wikibook Creating a Virtual Machine by Jeffrey Meunier and other Wikibooks contributors.
This text is incorporated into the wikibook as Register VM in Swift. It is a direct translation from C into Swift of the chapter Register VM in C.
